_about: Shown on the Validation page. Every number is copied from a result file in verification/ (named in 'file'); update together.

tests.id_txt: GPU vs CPU: hasil mesin kartu grafis sama dengan mesin acuan di prosesor pada medan asli (kotak Manggarai, 2 jam hujan 1 Jan 2020).
tests.en_txt: GPU vs CPU: the graphics-card engine gives the same result as the processor reference on real terrain (Manggarai box, first 2 h of the 1 Jan 2020 storm).

tests.id_txt: Neraca air: hujan + air hulu = resapan + keluar + ke laut + tersimpan. Diuji otomatis dan dilaporkan di setiap simulasi.
tests.en_txt: Water balance: rain + upstream inflow = infiltration + outflow + sea + storage. Tested automatically and reported with every run.
metrics: Mass error, whole region 30 h (90 m)

tests.id_txt: Uji analitik gelombang banjir di dataran datar (Hunter dkk. 2005): skema numerik yang sama dengan mesin v2.
tests.en_txt: Analytical flood-wave test on a flat plane (Hunter et al. 2005): same numerical scheme as engine v2.

tests.id_txt: Dibanding model terbitan SFINCS 2.4.0 (Deltares) pada medan, hujan dan kekasaran yang sama (mesin v1, skema sama; v2 akan diuji ulang).
tests.en_txt: Against the published SFINCS 2.4.0 model (Deltares) on the same terrain, rain and roughness (engine v1, same scheme; v2 re-run pending).

tests.id_txt: Banjir nyata: dengan hujan satelit GPM IMERG dan saluran primer/sekunder Dinas SDA DKI ditoreh ke medan, model mengenai 72–81 % laporan warga PetaBencana pada tiga banjir, dan 46–64 % poligon genangan resmi per RT dari Dinas SDA DKI (Jakarta Satu). Luas genangan 1 Jan 2020 di Jakarta: model 87 km², laporan Pemprov DKI 156 km² (tanpa saluran DSDA: 143 km²).
tests.en_txt: Observed floods: with GPM IMERG satellite rain and the DKI water agency's primary/secondary drains carved into the terrain, the model hits 72–81 % of PetaBencana citizen reports in three floods and 46–64 % of the official flood records per RT of the DKI water agency (Jakarta Satu). Flooded area in Jakarta on 1 Jan 2020: model 87 km², city government report 156 km² (without the DSDA drains: 143 km²).
metrics: DSDA flood records per RT hit, 2020 / 2021 / 2025
Drain sink on built cells (1–40 mm/h tested)

tests.id_txt: Kedalaman: di titik laporan, genangan model lebih dangkal dari yang dilaporkan warga. Uji kepekaan dengan hujan satelit dikali 1,5 dan 2: kedalaman 2020 jadi pas pada ×1,5, tetapi luas genangan Jakarta naik ke 200 km² (laporan 156 km²); 2021 baru pas pada ×2, 2025 sudah terlalu dalam pada ×1,5. Tidak ada satu faktor yang cocok, jadi aplikasi tetap memakai hujan apa adanya.
tests.en_txt: Depth: at report points the modelled water is shallower than citizens reported. Sensitivity runs with satellite rain times 1.5 and 2: 2020 depths match at ×1.5, but the flooded area in Jakarta rises to 200 km² (reported 156 km²); 2021 matches only at ×2, 2025 is already too deep at ×1.5. No single factor fits, so the app keeps the rain as observed.
metrics: Median depth at reports, new pack (2020 · 2021 · 2025)
